legend: This problem was supposed to have a cool statement but I forgot to add it.

Given two numbers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$, consider the set of integers a$$$a$$$, a+1$$$a + 1$$$, a+2$$$a + 2$$$, …, a+b−1$$$a + b - 1$$$. Partition this set into two nonempty sets such that each element belongs to exactly one set and the GCD of the sum of the sets is maximized. What is that maximum GCD?
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤100$$$1 \le t \le 100$$$). The description of the test cases follows.
The first line contains two space separated integers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (1≤a≤105$$$1 \le a \le 10^5$$$, 2≤b≤105$$$2 \le b \le 10^5$$$).
It is guaranteed that the sum of a$$$a$$$ over all test cases is at most 105$$$10^5$$$.
It is also guaranteed that the sum of b$$$b$$$ over all test cases is at most 105$$$10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, output a single line, the maximum possible GCD.
note: In the first test case, the numbers are [11,12,13,14]$$$[11, 12, 13, 14]$$$ which we can partition into [11,14]$$$[11, 14]$$$ and [12,13]$$$[12, 13]$$$. The sum of the sets are 11+14=25$$$11 + 14 = 25$$$ and 12+13=25$$$12 + 13 = 25$$$ and GCD(25,25)=25$$$(25, 25) = 25$$$. Guys after reading this, please be sure to orz Richard (both of them).

In the second test case, the set of numbers is [3,4,5]$$$[3, 4, 5]$$$ which we partition into [3,5]$$$[3, 5]$$$ and [4]$$$[4]$$$. The sum of the subsets are 3+5=8$$$3 + 5 = 8$$$ and 4$$$4$$$ and GCD(4,8)=4$$$(4, 8) = 4$$$.

legend.ai: 这道题本来应该有一个很酷的题面，但我忘了添加。
给定两个数 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$，考虑整数集合 a$$$a$$$、a+1$$$a + 1$$$、a+2$$$a + 2$$$、…、a+b−1$$$a + b - 1$$$。将这个集合划分为两个非空集合，使得每个元素恰好属于其中一个集合，并最大化两个集合元素之和的最大公约数。这个最大公约数是多少？

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例数量 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤100$$$1 \le t \le 100$$$)。接下来是测试用例的描述。
保证所有测试用例中 a$$$a$$$ 的总和不超过 105$$$10^5$$$。
还保证所有测试用例中 b$$$b$$$ 的总和不超过 105$$$10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，表示可能的最大公约数。
